summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on 18 August 2026 reporting PDMR share transactions. Sharon Hague, President of English Language Learning, acquired 2,604 ordinary shares at GBP 6.91 each following exercise of options under the company's Save for Shares Global Plan on 14 August 2026, with total consideration of GBP 17,993.64. Shares were transferred into her Share Plan Account. This is a routine disclosure of managerial share dealings, not a special-situation corporate event. No strategic implications, deal terms, or advisory roles are involved. What to watch: none; purely administrative notification.
